title: PR #137 · F11 and F12 drop on tab

lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 137, for issue 133: F11 and F12 drop the selection on the previous and next tab.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request one thirty-seven, for issue one thirty-three: F eleven and F twelve drop the selection on the previous and next tab.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what this PR adds, how it was built and verified, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
You press F12 to drop the selected files on the next tab, or F11 for the previous one.
lines.say: You press F twelve to drop the selected files on the next tab, or F eleven for the previous one.

lines.caption: Each key has a second action entry of its own, with no menu label, like F5 for Reload.
lines.say: Each key has a second action entry of its own, with no menu label, like F five for Reload.

lines.caption: Both entries call the handlers that pull request 128 added, unchanged.
The drop works as before: move or copy, and nothing at all from a text field.
Alt+Page Up and Alt+Page Down keep their own entries, keys and menu items.
lines.say: Alt Page Up and Alt Page Down keep their own entries, keys and menu items.

lines.caption: The Alt keys are two-key chords; F11 and F12 are single keys Thunar didn't use.
lines.say: The Alt keys are two-key chords; F eleven and F twelve are single keys Thoonar didn't use.

lines.caption: A GTK shortcut path holds only one key, so each action gets a second entry with its own key.
lines.say: A G T K shortcut path holds only one key, so each action gets a second entry with its own key.

lines.caption: Each new line copies its neighbour, with a new path and key, no label, and the same handler.
The PR changes the window's action table and its header, and adds a test and this page.
To undo it, revert this PR. A desktop that binds F11 or F12 itself wins over Thunar.
lines.say: To undo it, revert this PR. A desktop that binds F eleven or F twelve itself wins over Thoonar.

lines.caption: Part 2. How it was built and verified.
It copies the pattern of Reload's second key, and reuses the drop actions from pull request 128.
The packages were built in the cloud container, with no warnings in the changed files.
All 28 tests passed on that build, before the review's fixes to the test.
lines.say: All twenty-eight tests passed on that build, before the review's fixes to the test.

lines.caption: F12 moved the file across the split into the next tab, and F11 moved it back.
lines.say: F twelve moved the file across the split into the next tab, and F eleven moved it back.

lines.caption: Alt+Page Down and Alt+Page Up still moved it, and the starting tab stayed active.
lines.say: Alt Page Down and Alt Page Up still moved it, and the starting tab stayed active.

lines.caption: With the focus in the location bar, F12 and F11 moved nothing.
lines.say: With the focus in the location bar, F twelve and F eleven moved nothing.

lines.caption: After the review's fixes, the smoke test and this test were run again, and both passed.
CI's first run built the PR and passed the explainer check, and its review found two low findings.
On the fixed head, CI's build, all its tests, the explainer and the review passed, with 254 shots.
lines.say: On the fixed head, CI's build, all its tests, the explainer and the review passed, with two hundred fifty-four shots.

lines.caption: The screenshot audit passed: all 254 of CI's shots were OK.
lines.say: The screenshot audit passed: all two hundred fifty-four of CI's shots were OK.

lines.caption: Not run: a desktop that grabs F11 or F12.
lines.say: Not run: a desktop that grabs F eleven or F twelve.

lines.caption: A fresh agent reviewed the branch before the first push: four findings, two fixed, both in the test.
The Alt keys got a pair of shots each, and the location bar step now presses F11 too.
lines.say: The Alt keys got a pair of shots each, and the location bar step now presses F eleven too.

lines.caption: Skipped: the missing explainer, now written, and an older F10 bug outside this change.
lines.say: Skipped: the missing explainer, now written, and an older F ten bug outside this change.

lines.caption: CI's review of the first push found two low findings.
R2, comments in the test that the project's rules forbid, was fixed by removing them.
lines.say: R two, comments in the test that the project's rules forbid, was fixed by removing them.

lines.caption: R1, the older F10 bug, was accepted by the owner, with no follow-up issue.
lines.say: R one, the older F ten bug, was accepted by the owner, with no follow-up issue.

lines.caption: The review of the second push found nothing new.
How the keys behave under a desktop that binds them is only seen after the merge.
The PR page has CI's comments and screenshots, and a link to its first run.
Part 3. What comes later: nothing depends on this issue.
The batch runs issue 135 next, a search bar change that doesn't build on this one.
lines.say: The batch runs issue one thirty-five next, a search bar change that doesn't build on this one.

lines.caption: The older F10 bug stays: the owner accepted it without a follow-up issue.
lines.say: The older F ten bug stays: the owner accepted it without a follow-up issue.

lines.caption: In short: F11 and F12 are now quicker keys for dropping files on the previous or next tab.
lines.say: In short: F eleven and F twelve are now quicker keys for dropping files on the previous or next tab.
